He objects to two pages showing a fox caught in a snare, saying they frightened his four-year-old, and asks that the book be removed or moved to the adult section. He states on the form that he has read the whole book. Our selection policy says challenged items stay available while under review; a committee of three staff reviews them within 30 days, judging the work as a whole against professional reviews and suitability for its intended age. The book received positive reviews in two trade journals, both recommending it for ages 4-8, and was shortlisted for a regional children's book award. It has been borrowed 31 times with no earlier complaints. Mr Harlow has asked for a reply "by Friday" and copied in a local councillor.

q2.instructions: Does Mr Harlow say he has read the entire book?

criteria.true: He says he has read all of it
criteria.false: He says he has only seen part of it
